::: {#def-posterior}
#### Posterior distribution

The **posterior distribution** of a parameter $\param$,
given observed data $\vY = \vy$,
is the [conditional distribution](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-cond-pdf)
of $\param$ given $\vY = \vy$.
Its density or probability mass function is written $\p(\param \mid \vy)$.
:::
